patch_description: The current operating point (corr 0.89, 14.2 reversals, lag 0.34) is well inside the smoothness frontier — Gen 72 demonstrated corr 0.96 is reachable while reversals stay near 14 thanks to the clamp+damp+escalation stack. Three targeted relaxations move toward that frontier point: (1) raise the sigma_acc cap from 0.6σ_r to 0.85σ_r so the constant-velocity model trusts genuine fast dynamics more (less flattening of real corners, better tracking/lag), (2) scale the refinement pass Q by 0.5 instead of 0.25 so pass-2 re-sharpens dynamics instead of over-smoothing, and (3) gate the terminal Whittaker polish on substantial residual ripple (r_std > 0.3σ_r) so a clean smoother output isn't pointlessly over-smoothed (that only adds lag and depresses correlation). The velocity clamp guards remain in place calibrated against the robust σ_r, so reversal counts should stay protected while correlation rises toward ~0.93.
